title: fix(ai): apply max_tokens to Gemini requests

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+package gemini
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"math"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"google.golang.org/genai"
+
+	"github.com/cloudposse/atmos/pkg/ai/agent/base"
+	"github.com/cloudposse/atmos/pkg/ai/tools"
+	"github.com/cloudposse/atmos/pkg/ai/types"
+)
+
+// newClientAgainst returns a Client whose requests go to a test server that records the
+// generationConfig and tools of the last request body.
+func newClientAgainst(t *testing.T, maxTokens int, generationConfig *map[string]any, requestTools *[]any) *Client {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		var request map[string]any
+		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(body, &request))
+		*generationConfig, _ = request["generationConfig"].(map[string]any)
+		*requestTools, _ = request["tools"].([]any)
+
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"ok"}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}]}`))
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+
+	genaiClient, err := genai.NewClient(context.Background(), &genai.ClientConfig{
+		APIKey:      "test-key",
+		Backend:     genai.BackendGeminiAPI,
+		HTTPOptions: genai.HTTPOptions{BaseURL: server.URL},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return &Client{
+		client: genaiClient,
+		config: &base.Config{Enabled: true, Model: DefaultModel, APIKey: "test-key", MaxTokens: maxTokens},
+	}
+}
+
+func TestClient_SendsConfiguredMaxTokens(t *testing.T) {
+	messages := []types.Message{{Role: types.RoleUser, Content: "hi"}}
+	tool := &mockTool{name: "list_stacks", description: "List stacks"}
+
+	sends := map[string]func(c *Client) error{
+		"SendMessage": func(c *Client) error {
+			_, err := c.SendMessage(context.Background(), "hi")
+			return err
+		},
+		"SendMessageWithHistory": func(c *Client) error {
+			_, err := c.SendMessageWithHistory(context.Background(), messages)
+			return err
+		},
+		"SendMessageWithTools": func(c *Client) error {
+			_, err := c.SendMessageWithTools(context.Background(), "hi", []tools.Tool{tool})
+			return err
+		},
+		"SendMessageWithToolsAndHistory": func(c *Client) error {
+			_, err := c.SendMessageWithToolsAndHistory(context.Background(), messages, []tools.Tool{tool})
+			return err
+		},
+	}
+
+	for name, send := range sends {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			var generationConfig map[string]any
+			var requestTools []any
+			client := newClientAgainst(t, 1234, &generationConfig, &requestTools)
+
+			require.NoError(t, send(client))
+
+			assert.EqualValues(t, 1234, generationConfig["maxOutputTokens"])
+			if name == "SendMessageWithTools" || name == "SendMessageWithToolsAndHistory" {
+				assert.NotEmpty(t, requestTools, "tool declarations must reach the request")
+			} else {
+				assert.Empty(t, requestTools)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestClient_ClampsMaxTokensToInt32(t *testing.T) {
+	var generationConfig map[string]any
+	var requestTools []any
+	// 1<<32 + 5 would wrap to 5 if converted to int32 without clamping.
+	client := newClientAgainst(t, 1<<32+5, &generationConfig, &requestTools)
+
+	_, err := client.SendMessage(context.Background(), "hi")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	assert.EqualValues(t, math.MaxInt32, generationConfig["maxOutputTokens"])
+}
